items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: my son Gary is my manager. He runs all this.

ctx.x: What is your current activity in terms of clinics and jazz education? What form is it predom – mostly taking?

I still do clinics and concerts, and I have – in that same town, LeMars, Iowa, one of the people who helped me to start this institute has all my music. We have a publishing thing there, and whenever I get a call to go – my son Gary is my manager. He runs all this. They’ll call him and say they want me for a clinic, such and such a place.
